jobs.desc: We are seeking a high-caliber programmatic role who balances robust technical expertise with a strong commercial mindset. In this dual-impact role, you will act as the core product expert for WPP Media Solutions, driving incremental revenue growth by evangelizing our programmatic and data products across GroupM agencies and client portfolios. Concurrently, you will lead the end-to-end execution, daily optimization, and strategic servicing of advertising campaigns to ensure operational excellence and maximal client ROI. 【Key Responsibilities】 1.Commercial & Product Evangelism: - Deliver expected revenue targets defined for WPP Media Solutions. - Influence and drive adoption of programmatic & data solutions via workshops, training, brainstorms, and pitch sessions with internal agency client teams and external brand clients. - Proactively identify and pitch incremental investment opportunities for existing clients. 2.Campaign Activation & Optimization: - Oversee the implementation, management, and daily hands-on optimization of programmatic campaigns (across DV360, TTD, Amazon DSP) to meet client KPIs. - Competently create data-driven media plans, audience buying strategies, and cross-channel testing roadmaps. 3.Client & Stakeholder Management: - Provide high-touch direct client servicing, translating complex technical campaign performance metrics into actionable business insights during weekly reviews and briefings. - Work closely with internal Operations, Supply, and Hub teams locally and globally to ensure smooth roll-out, financial accuracy, and campaign reconciliation. 4.Team Mentorship: - Support and guide junior team members, monitoring and prioritizing workloads, and leading by example to encourage their professional training and development. 【Skills & Experience Required】 1.Programmatic Core: 3-5+ years of proven experience in programmatic activation with deep hands-on expertise in major trading platforms (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP). 2.Commercial Agility: Proven track record or strong aptitude for business development, client pitching, and product presentation; comfortable holding a revenue-driven mindset. 3.Analytical Mindset: Analytically minded with an advanced ability to handle large data sets to identify trends, execute A/B testing, and maintain financial/reconciliation accuracy. 4.Communication Mastery: Exceptional bilingual presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical operations and brand/agency stakeholders.
